newsitem.title: USA: CME says March pork bellies expire at noon Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: CME says March pork bellies expire at noon Tuesday.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange said Tuesday that the March pork belly futures contract expires at 1200 CST/1800 GMT Tuesday, one day earlier than published in the official exchange calendar.
"Due to administrative error they originally included Friday as a business day which we now know is not a business day," CME spokeswoman Annette Wallace said.
The CME is closed Friday for the Good Friday holiday. On Tuesday it issued a notice to traders informing them that the contract expires Tuesday.
Exchange rules state pork belly futures contracts expire during the business day immediately preceding the last three business days of the month, Wallace said.
